theory_link.definition: correlation between environmental state available earlier along the route and environmental state realized later at the destination, estimated without using the focal outcome year
theory_link.secondary_binary_bridge: q = 0.5 + asin(rho)/pi under a centered bivariate-Gaussian sign-threshold approximation
theory_link.bridge_role: secondary model-conditional interpretation only; rho remains the primary empirical coordinate

lane_a_wigeon.role: retrospective mechanistic bridge; not independent confirmation because phase-retention outcomes are already known
lane_a_wigeon.route_geometry_rule: for each staging segment, use the median observed event latitude and longitude across the existing 256-event table; coordinates only, not phase values, define the historical ERA5 extraction point
lane_a_wigeon.environmental_state: annual TGS onset day under the already frozen January-July 5C cumulative-minimum rule
lane_a_wigeon.pair_connectivity: for each ordered consecutive staging-segment pair, separately detrend origin and destination annual TGS onset on year over 2000-2017, then compute signed Pearson rho
lane_a_wigeon.primary_model: phase_change ~ origin_phase * z_connectivity + z_progress + z_endpoint + z_progress:z_endpoint + C(year), with individual-clustered uncertainty
lane_a_wigeon.directional_prediction: negative interaction: higher predictive connectivity strengthens phase correction, so lambda = 1 + beta_origin + beta_interaction*z_connectivity decreases as connectivity rises
lane_a_wigeon.support_rule: directional prediction supported only if the interaction estimate is negative and its two-sided 95% clustered confidence interval excludes zero
lane_a_wigeon.null_rule: if estimable but the confidence interval includes zero, record NOT_SUPPORTED without retuning
claim_ceiling: does not demonstrate historical climate-driven degradation of predictive connectivity
does not by itself test community-level coordination hysteresis
tests whether phase correction covaries with a pre-outcome route-information coordinate

lane_b_broad_birds.role: cross-species generality test of the information axis, separate from the frozen universal-speed falsification
lane_b_broad_birds.target_rows: species x year x breeding-range grid cells with valid bird arrival and green-up dates
lane_b_broad_birds.source_cell_rule: for each species and target breeding cell, choose the geographically nearest species cell marked migratory-range with strictly lower latitude; ties are resolved by numeric cell id; source selection uses spatial/range metadata only
lane_b_broad_birds.connectivity_window: trailing 8 calendar years ending at year t-1
lane_b_broad_birds.connectivity_state: green-up day at source and target cells
lane_b_broad_birds.connectivity_processing: within each trailing window, separately regress source and target green-up day on year and correlate the residuals
lane_b_broad_birds.primary_model: primary_response ~ z_connectivity + z_destination_greenup_anomaly + z_bird_speed + s(year, bs='re') + s(species_cell, bs='re') + s(species, bs='re')
lane_b_broad_birds.directional_prediction: negative coefficient: stronger pre-existing route predictive connectivity is associated with smaller realized arrival-green-up mismatch
lane_b_broad_birds.support_rule: directional prediction supported only if the z_connectivity estimate is negative and its two-sided 95% confidence interval excludes zero
lane_b_broad_birds.null_rule: if estimable but the interval includes zero, record NOT_SUPPORTED; do not redefine source cells, window length, or mismatch response
lane_b_broad_birds.separation_from_existing_result: the frozen 55-species universal speed-ratio falsification remains unchanged regardless of this result

headline_requires: the Bayesian synthetic mechanism and topology-dependent hysteresis remain robust
at least one natural-data lane supports the preregistered information-axis direction
claims about recovery hysteresis remain synthetic unless a time series with information degradation and recovery is analyzed
forbidden_reframings: do not claim that migration distance itself is predictive connectivity
do not call same-year source-destination correlation pre-commitment information
do not convert a null empirical result into support by changing the connectivity window or source-cell rule
do not claim a natural hysteresis threshold from synthetic cue-accuracy values
